name: Nord C2D
description: Nord C2D combo organ: every control of its manual's MIDI controller list, the asterisked ones on the Swell and Great manuals' channels.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/nord/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/nord/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI controller list, with its printed name, sent as the control change it prints on the channel of each manual it is on. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
The list prints controller numbers only: every value is 0 - 127, and a setting chosen from a list (a model, a waveform, an effect type) is a number here, not a choice.

The channel variables are the Swell, Great and Bass manuals' MIDI channels (the System menu); 1, 2 and 3 here, which may not be the instrument's. A row without the asterisk is laid out on the Swell channel; the asterisked rows other than the drawbars on the Swell and Great, the asterisk's `Bass and/or` not saying for which of them the Bass is meant.
Left out, the pedals, the wheel and bank select: 64 Sustain Pedal, 4 Swell Pedal.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same messages when its panel is used, where its MIDI settings allow

parameters.name: Rotary Speaker Control
parameters.description: On the Swell manual's channel. Printed: Rotary Speaker Control (0 = Slow, 64 = Stop. 127 = Fast).
